Following are some of the common water purification methods.
i.frisriltation Distilation is a filtration method that has been used fora longtime.This process
starts by heating water in a container until it reaches boiling point.The water vapors that rise
upward during this process are cooled and condensed from the original container. Through
condensation, the water vapours become liquid water and are collected as purified water and
the heavier contaminants stay behind in the original container.
ii,Reyarse Osmosis: Reverse osmosis is a purification process that utilizes a semi-permeable
membrane.Pumps are used to push the impure water into themembrane that blocks most of the
impuritieswhileletting purifiedwater gothroughto theotherside.
